notes: Setups (Looks > Setup): keep how everything is set under a name (looks, shortcuts, the pen, tool settings, favourite brushes) and switch back and forth; they travel in the settings file
Pen button (Looks): choose what the button on the side of the pen does in Canvas: the menu, the brush ring, pick a colour, erase, undo, or move the canvas
Favourite brushes: drag them into your own order in the brush library
A new canvas starts with the size, colour and paper of the last one you made
